problems.quote: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, an open-weight model.
problems.explanation: The claims never state that Ripple-65B Preview is open-weight as a fact. They only cite a 'U.S. open-weight state of the art' benchmark and availability on hosting platforms, so the label is presented without support.

problems.quote: ReTrace: agent runs become workflows, 24% cheaper per task
problems.explanation: The 24% lower cost per task is a benchmark the authors report on their own platform, but the card presents it as established fact without attribution.

problems.quote: It says streaming gives two point one to two point five times more samples per second.
problems.explanation: The claim gives the 2.1–2.5x speedup only 'when using four DataLoader workers'. The script drops this condition and so overstates the general applicability of the figure.
